name: B10-0095/2024 (The Left) – The case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Türkiye to stop punishing journalists and critics. It condemns the prison sentence given to journalist Bülent Mumay for his social media posts and says independent media face harassment and censorship. It asks Türkiye to release people it says are held for political reasons, to make its laws on terrorism, disinformation and protests fairer, and to protect free reporting. It also asks the European Union to make rights and rule of law a condition of its relationship with Türkiye, and to make it easier for Turkish journalists to get visas.

- Nothing changes yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- It targets Türkiye's government, courts and jailed critics, and the European Union's dealings with Türkiye.
- Next, the text goes to European Union institutions, member states and Turkish authorities; they decide whether to act.
